actions.action: Place the plant in bright shade or indirect light for days 1-3
Give it 1-2 hours of morning sun during week 1 by moving it into position
Add about an hour of sun every few days from week 2 onward
Watch the leaves for bleaching or scorch
If bleaching appears, back off sun for a few days and then go slower
Keep it in morning sun with afternoon shade long term, especially in hot climates
Move it out from under the fuchsia to a brighter spot long term
Check that the hanging pot has drainage holes
Water deeply, then let the soil dry out completely before watering again
Propagate dropped leaves by laying them on soil
Use a gritty, fast-draining succulent mix
